messages:
rachel: Quick report from magnet-32k int4 onboarding: observed an odd epoch/handshake mismatch at the stitch boundary. Pattern: prefill ~12k, append ~6k, resume -> small run (4-6 tokens) repeats and later tokens diverge. Repro intermittent (~1/350).

diego: Which policy? fold or reset? Any artifacts?

rachel: kv_policy=fold (we need latency). If we force reset it's 100% clean but too slow for target flows. Uploaded artifacts to /artifacts/onboard/2934567890.tar.gz.

mina: Curious note: logs show epoch headers identical but the stitcher sometimes re-evaluates posscale for appended segment. If posscale is recalculated vs continued, RoPE phase can desync and produce duplication. Do you have per-layer phase checks?

rachel: Here's the critical snippet we captured:

[cache] prefill id=0x1a2b fp=0xcafe len=12096 slot=9 epoch=58
[cache] append id=0x1a2c fp=0xcaff len+=6144 slot=9 epoch=58
stitcher: posscale_eval=dynamic for append segment
gen: step=12099 tok=215 dup window=12096-12102
[cache] post_fp=0xcaff != pre_fp=0xcafe

diego: That posscale_eval=dynamic is suspicious. We have two options to triage: 1) force "pos_continuity=true" in the stitcher so appended tokens use a strict offset continuation; 2) instrument per-layer phase checksums after stitch to see which layer changes. Which do you want me to try?

rachel: Start with phase checksums (lightweight) and a short run of 10k deterministic iterations under qemu-int4. If that reproduces, toggle pos_continuity. Also try running same test on arm64 vs x86. We saw arch variance in earlier issues.

mina: I'll add the phase checksum hook and a debug flag that dumps per-layer checksum hex after each stitch. If checksum diverges we can map it to a specific layer and determine if posscale or indexing is wrong.

diego: FWIW I also want to rule out metadata races: earlier we had an async merge path that updated fingerprint without a memory barrier. If the stitcher reads the slot concurrently, you can get one writer's view with mixed-old/new metadata. Add a tiny memory barrier or CAS around fingerprint update for the experiment.

rachel: Good call. I'll patch two branches: one with the phase-check instrumentation + pos_continuity toggle, and one with CAS barrier around fp update. Running both on perf-lab and a Dedicated QA node to compare frequencies.

build-bot: Created ticket #5120: "stitcher: epoch-handshake vs posscale continuity mismatch on magnet-32k int4" (reporter: rachel) :ticket:  (links: /artifacts/onboard/2934567890.tar.gz)

mina: If the CAS barrier removes the repro it's likely a race. If phase checksums show drift even with barrier, it's a stitcher posscale bug. If both help, we might need small atomic ordering + a corrected posscale path.

diego: For the long-term fix, we should prefer a lightweight handshake: append carries a small epoch-token and stitcher validates epoch continuity before applying dynamic posscale. That avoids global locks and keeps latency low.

rachel: Running 20k deterministic passes now (qemu-int4, seeded RNG) across both branches and archs. Will post results and failing slot dumps. TLDR: intermittent duplication at prefill-append join; investigating posscale continuity vs metadata ordering; reset still a working workaround but too slow for target SLOs. :mag:
